reason: Pre-Excel audit corrections: hole-size safety for doubled 0.4mm elastic, remove premature non-elastic-wire assumption, and rename misleading generic stone profile.

changes.rule: For bracelet beads intended to support doubled 0.4mm elastic, finished clear through-hole target is >=1.0mm. Do not use 0.8mm as the default acceptable lower bound. Preferred sourcing note is 1.0-1.2mm where the material/size safely permits it.
changes.exceptions: Pearls, half-drilled focal pieces, fragile/specialist materials and design-specific components keep their own drilling logic; exceptions must be explicit rather than inherited from the general bead rule.

changes.reason: The profile is used by lapis lazuli, obsidian, tourmaline, malachite and multiple agates; the old name incorrectly implied that all mapped materials were agate.

changes.rule: Do not pre-decide coated beading wire / tiger-tail. The material/structure remains open (e.g. coated wire, nylon or other stringing system) until design/engineering selection is explicit. Existing third-party wire photo stays research-only and must not appear as the final standard item image.

specs: 8mm round / finished clear hole >=1.0mm / main comparison spec
10-20mm freeform or faceted focal / finished clear hole normally >=1.0mm; batch/design exception explicit
10-20mm flat/freeform/faceted focal / hole normally >=1.0mm / select by optical effect
12-20mm freeform/faceted focal / hole normally >=1.0mm / select by inclusion composition
10-20mm freeform/carved piece / hole normally >=1.0mm when the material benefits from it
7-8mm round/near-round / through-drilled bracelet use target hole >=1.0mm
8-9mm round/near-round / through-drilled bracelet use target hole >=1.0mm
8-12mm baroque/irregular / hole by batch and design

profile_alias_rule: All CRM-M mappings that previously pointed to STONE_AGATE are interpreted as STONE_GENERAL from this version onward; no material identity changes.
